title: Packages marked delivered by carriers but not received by customers
situation: 22 customers report orders marked delivered but missing, including 3 VIP accounts and SAR 2,401 at risk.
hypothesis: Carrier falsely marked packages as delivered

params.reply_en: We see your order was marked delivered but you haven't received it. We are checking with the courier right now and will update you by email within 24 hours.
params.reply_ar: نرى أن طلبك قد تم تسليمه ولكنك لم تستلمه. نحن نتحقق من شركة الشريحة الآن وسنوافيك بالتحديث عبر البريد الإلكتروني خلال 24 ساعة.

actions.why: Acknowledge the missing delivery issue and set clear follow-up timing.

params.note: Carrier falsely marking deliveries as complete for 22 orders.

actions.why: Escalate to logistics to investigate the courier route and GPS logs.
Tag conversations for carrier performance reporting.

reply_other.es: Vemos que tu pedido aparece como entregado pero no lo has recibido. Lo estamos consultando con la empresa de transporte y te informaremos por correo en 24 horas.

alternatives.hypothesis: Packages left with incorrect neighbors or reception desk
alternatives.why: Some customers mention items left at reception or with neighbors.
